[ASSISTANT_SAID] Social media has significantly impacted TV ratings and viewership through live-tweeting, creating a sense of community among viewers.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Networks and actors can post teasers, trailers, and behind-the-scenes footage on social media to generate buzz for their shows.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Streaming services like Netflix, Amazon Prime, and Hulu have reduced the need for viewers to watch TV shows at specific times or on TV sets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, social media has radically changed the way people watch and interact with television.

[USER] User asks if traditional TV ratings are becoming less relevant with the rise of streaming and social media.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Traditional TV ratings are becoming less relevant due to the rise of streaming and social media.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Streaming services often do not release viewership numbers, making comparisons difficult.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Binge-watching means viewers may watch entire seasons weeks or months after airing, which traditional ratings do not reflect.
